value.rationale: Resolving binary diffraction from one deterministic unit-modulus coded pattern is a natural minimal-measurement question. At every odd prime the complete fibre classification achieves the absolute maximum allowed by singleton ambiguity; for all composites even the two-point stratum has nontrivial collisions. A uniform algebraic intensity separation bound makes the exact uniqueness robust in principle. The classification covers an unbounded family rather than a small experimental enumeration, and does not merely rephrase an unmasked Fourier property.
